description: Turn Google Ads auto-apply recommendations ON or OFF. Set enabled=false to PAUSE (stop auto-applying — recommendations are still suggested, just not applied automatically). Pass all=true to apply to every resolvable subscription (the fix for runaway auto-applied budget/bid changes). Subscriptions with an UNKNOWN type/resource name cannot be mutated by the API and are skipped and reported.

all.description: If true, apply to every resolvable subscription. Ignores resourceName.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

enabled.description: true = ENABLED (auto-apply on); false = PAUSED (auto-apply off).

resourceName.description: Specific subscription resource_name to set (from gads_list_recommendation_subscriptions). Required when all is not true.

name: gads_set_recommendation_subscription
